name: PT Kioson Komersial Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Kioson Komersial Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the online trading and e-commerce business in Indonesia. The company provides software and hardware platforms to support micro, small, and middle businesses through the Kioson Cash Point partnership system. It is also involved in the transferring funds or sending money electronic money transactions, services, development, printing, industries, trade, transportation, workshops, agriculture, technology and digital products, and warehousing services. PT Kioson Komersial Indonesia Tbk was founded in 2015 and is based in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
